awg_profile_standard_desc: QUIC I1 signature, balanced obfuscation — recommended

vpn_forwarder_no_route_pressure: All route queues are clear. No drop pressure detected.

vpn_no_backends_desc: Attach registered servers to the load balancer tunnel pool to route traffic.
vpn_public_endpoint_hint: Configured domain or IP:port entry point for the central Load Balancer. If unset, the portal automatically detects its public IP.
vpn_server_no_awg_warning: This server does not have AmneziaWG (AWG) configured.
vpn_sessions_stale: Session data unavailable — showing last known values
upstream_update_available_notice: A newer upstream release is available. Review changes and consider updating container images.

vpn_diag_summary_healthy: Dataplane forwarding operating within expected performance thresholds

vpn_diag_summary_actionable_issues: Active VPN session routing or dataplane issues detected

vpn_problem_route_queue_pressure: High queue pressure detected on forwarder route

deploy_vps_no_region_stock: No region currently has stock for this plan
deploy_vps_no_os: No operating system is installable on this plan
deploy_vps_catalog_stale: Showing a cached catalog from {age}. Prices and availability may be out of date.

deploy_vps_placement_out_of_stock: Out of stock in this datacenter
deploy_vps_placement_choice_cleared: The previous datacenter choice is no longer available
setup_intents_desc: Durable setup jobs tracked by the panel itself. They keep progressing when no browser is open.
setup_intents_none: No setup approval has been recorded
setup_intents_cancel_confirm: Revoke this setup approval? The panel will stop tracking this order. The VPS itself is not cancelled.
setup_intents_resume_confirm: Resume this setup job? The panel will continue installing on the server it already registered. A step whose outcome is unknown is verified, not repeated.
setup_intents_credentials_hint: This job needs an SSH credential. Place the order with a managed key, or run setup manually with a password.
setup_intents_approve_confirm: Approve setup for this order? The panel will track it and keep working after this browser is closed. Nothing is installed until the server is ready and its host identity is confirmed.
setup_intents_saved: Setup approval saved - the panel will keep tracking this order
setup_intents_already_saved: A setup approval is already saved for this order
setup_intents_protocol_invalid: Enter one of: awg, vless, naive
gigahost_status_ip_while_provisioning: The provider assigned this address, but has not confirmed the server is ready. It is not reachable as a VPN backend yet.
gigahost_status_next_action_wait: Wait for the provider to finish deploying
gigahost_status_next_action_retry: Review the failure, then retry setup
gigahost_status_next_action_check_health: Check the backend health on the VPN page
gigahost_status_next_action_check_provid: Check the order at the provider - no confirmed provider state is recorded
gigahost_status_read_only: Read-only details. Opening this performs no order, setup or cancellation.
gigahost_status_stale: Showing the last successful check. The provider could not be read since
gigahost_status_load_failed: Order status is unavailable - the last read failed and nothing was confirmed
policy_direct_egress_notice: Direct traffic exits from the Nexus ingress server's public WAN IP, not the client's home IP.
policy_preset_russia_inside_hint: Blocked and censored services (YouTube, Discord, Twitter, Cloudflare, etc.).
policy_preset_geoblock_hint: Foreign services that geo-block Russian IP ranges.
policy_preset_antifilter_domains_hint: Domains from the antifilter community list.
policy_preset_antifilter_ipv4_hint: Includes aggregated IP ranges. Some unrelated sites may also use the proxy.
policy_preset_custom_hint: One https:// list URL per line. The server validates every URL and rejects non-HTTPS or private targets.
policy_preset_unavailable_note: Russia outside is not offered: Nexus has no Russian egress.
policy_semantics_notice: Listed matches use PROXY. Public destinations observed through the gateway DNS and not listed can go DIRECT. Unknown destinations use PROXY. A proxy outage never falls back to DIRECT.
policy_limits_notice: Encrypted DNS and direct-IP connections may not be classified for direct routing; IPv6 PBR is unsupported in v1.
policy_save_refused: The server refused this change. The form was reloaded from the saved configuration.
policy_not_ready: Saving stays disabled until the saved settings load.
policy_upstream_intro: Choose which resolvers the gateway itself dials. This does not change the DNS servers written into generated client configurations.
policy_upstream_limit_note: The resolver asks only the first two entries in this order. Up to three entries can be stored: the third is kept, shown, and not queried.
policy_upstream_plain_warning: A plain DNS entry sends every query unencrypted to that resolver.
policy_upstream_mixed_warning: A plain entry after an encrypted one: when the encrypted resolver fails, queries continue in plaintext.
policy_upstream_client_config_notice: Generated client configurations keep their own DNS servers. This list only decides which resolvers the gateway dials while policy routing is on.
policy_upstream_not_queried_note: Not queried: the resolver asks only the first two entries in this order. This entry is stored and kept.
policy_upstream_enabled_save_notice: Saving re-downloads every list source and can fail because of them, in which case it is rolled back. An upstream-only change leaves the routing rules as they are, so the published policy generation and the routing evidence clients already have are kept; a save that changes rules rebuilds that evidence.
policy_upstream_activation_save_notice: Policy routing is stored as enabled but is not running. Saving tries to start it, which downloads the list and installs the data path.
policy_upstream_needs_source: Choose and save a policy list source before saving a resolver list.
policy_upstream_pin_hint: Base64 SHA-256 of the resolver certificate's public key. Encrypted transports only.
policy_upstream_save_failed: The resolver list was not saved
policy_upstream_save_refused: The editor was reloaded from the stored configuration.
policy_upstream_load_failed: Could not read the stored resolver list
policy_upstream_not_ready: Saving waits for the stored resolver list to load.
policy_upstream_conflict: Another change replaced the resolver list. Your edits are still in the editor and are not saved. Use Reload to see the newer list; that discards your edits.
policy_upstream_echo_mismatch: The server stored a different resolver list than the one sent
policy_upstream_state_inconsistent: Stored and running policy may disagree
policy_upstream_port_required: Plain DNS needs an explicit port.
policy_upstream_port_invalid: The port must be a whole number from 1 to 65535.
policy_upstream_address_invalid_doh: A DNS over HTTPS entry is a host and a port; the resolver requests /dns-query itself.
policy_upstream_duplicate: This resolver is already in the list.
policy_upstream_too_many: A resolver list holds at most three entries.
policy_upstream_health_none: This deployment does not report resolver health.
policy_upstream_health_off: No resolver health is available while policy routing is off.
policy_upstream_health_waiting: No resolver contact has been observed yet.
policy_upstream_health_not_in_list: Last resolver contacted: {upstream} (not in the current list; historical observation)
policy_upstream_failure_timeout: timeout, no answer within the deadline
policy_upstream_failure_network: network error at the transport level
policy_upstream_failure_invalid_response: the reply did not match the query
policy_upstream_failure_pin_mismatch: the pinned public key did not match
notifications_disabled_hint: Off by default. When disabled, the portal records events in its local history but sends nothing externally.
notifications_url_hint: HTTPS endpoint, for example https://gotify.example.com. Loopback HTTP is accepted only for local testing.
notifications_token_hint: Leave blank to keep the stored token. The token is encrypted at rest and never returned by the API.
notifications_min_severity_hint: Events below this severity are recorded in history but not sent externally.
notifications_cooldown_hint: Suppresses a repeated event of the same type for the same incident within this window.
notifications_test_save_failed: Save the notification settings before testing
notifications_test_detail: This is an explicit administrator test, not a real incident.
notifications_history_hint: Every event is recorded locally; the delivery status shows whether Gotify accepted it.
policy_client_hint: Choose one session incarnation to inspect the route evidence the panel already holds for it. Nothing here is a lookup: the panel reads retained state only, so a client's DNS name or a site's content is never queried.
policy_client_select_hint: Sessions are listed with their assigned address and connection name. A reconnecting client appears as a new session.
policy_client_evidence_hint: Decisions the router stored for addresses this session's own DNS answers produced. The cache keeps addresses, not query names, so an entry cannot say which domain produced it.
policy_client_flows_hint: Five-tuple decisions the packet path recorded for this incarnation. Activity time is the last packet, not the moment the route was chosen.
policy_client_drops_not_recorded: Dropped packets: not recorded per client yet, so no drop count is shown.
policy_client_application_not_observable: not observable by the panel. A routed packet, a DNS answer or a returning connection is not proof that a site or a video worked.
policy_client_load_failed: Could not read the client list
policy_client_no_clients: No client session is connected right now.
policy_client_failed: Could not read this client's state
policy_client_policy_off: Policy routing is off, so no per-client evidence exists. Enable policy routing to collect it.
policy_client_busy: Another diagnosis is in progress. Try again in a moment.
policy_client_empty_evidence: No address evidence is retained for this session.
policy_client_empty_flows: No live flow is recorded for this session.
policy_client_flow_count: {shown} of {total} flows in the visited window.
policy_client_partial_scan: This client owns more flows than one visit covers, so {scanned} of its records were visited; the count is a lower bound.
policy_client_stale_answer: The answer arrived after the selection changed, so it was discarded.
policy_client_state_route_generation_rep: route generation replaced: the selected incarnation ended
policy_client_state_route_absent: no route: the session holds no data-path route
policy_client_state_unknown_session: unknown session: an ended session cannot be told apart
policy_client_state_inconsistent: selection changed while reading: records withheld
policy_client_limit_application_success_: Whether the application worked cannot be observed by the panel.
policy_client_limit_proxy_return_not_mea: Return traffic through the proxy is not measured per flow.
policy_client_limit_route_cache_evidence: Only the route cache's retained decisions are shown.
policy_client_limit_session_end_not_dist: A session that ended is indistinguishable from an unknown one, because nothing retains a terminated session.
policy_client_limit_ipv6_not_supported: IPv6 is not evaluated or recorded by policy routing.
policy_client_limit_not_an_atomic_cross_: The sections are read one after another, so they are not one atomic snapshot of all subsystems.
policy_client_limit_selection_changed_du: The selection changed while it was being read, so the records were withheld.
policy_client_limit_session_registry_una: The session registry is unavailable, so a selection cannot be verified.
policy_client_limit_flow_scan_window_par: Only part of this client's flows were visited in one read.
policy_client_dns_hint: Answers the router actually saw for this session, with the addresses and decisions it wrote. This is history: an entry here stays after its evidence expires and is dropped only by age, capacity or session end.
policy_client_dns_empty: No DNS answer has been observed for this session yet.
policy_client_dns_not_recorded: DNS answers are not recorded by this build.
policy_client_limit_records_without_rout: Some answers arrived while the session had no registered route, so they carry no route generation.
policy_client_counters_live_note: Counters are read live at sampling time; packets in flight during the read are not included.
policy_client_reason_allocation_cdn_excl: proxy: allocation matched, but the range is a shared CDN
policy_client_corr_answer_after_decision: the answer arrived after this decision
policy_client_corr_expired_before_decisi: the evidence had expired before this decision
policy_client_corr_no_retained_answer: no retained answer named this address
policy_client_corr_dns_records_not_recor: DNS answers are not recorded by this build
policy_client_dns_events_hint: Every query the router handled for this session, including the ones that produced no usable answer. A query listed here is not route evidence: only a delivered, non-truncated answer can become that.
policy_client_dns_events_empty: No DNS query has been recorded for this session yet.
policy_client_dns_events_not_recorded: DNS queries are not recorded by this build.
policy_client_dns_events_coverage: {stored} queries stored · {collapsed} collapsed · {evicted} evicted · {aged} aged out
policy_client_return_authority_current_t: matched by the flow that owns this tuple now
policy_client_drops_hint: Packets this client sent that were refused before any flow record existed. Global counters cannot attribute these to a client; these rows can.
policy_client_drop_empty: No refusal retained for this client in the retention window.
policy_client_drop_not_recorded: This build did not record pre-flow refusals.
policy_client_drop_coverage: This generation: {session_keys} keys · retained {stored} · merged {merged} · evicted {evicted} · aged out {pruned} · ledger {keys}/{key_limit} keys · window {age}s (pruned on the next write, hidden from reads by age)
policy_client_limit_flow_evidence_instal: A forwarded flow whose decision record could not be installed is absent from this list; it was forwarded, so it is not a drop.
policy_client_limitations_label: What the recorded rows still cannot state
policy_client_filter_hint: Narrows the rows already read for this session by destination address, port or name. It reads no new state and sends no query.
policy_client_corr_dns_names_not_retaine: the retained address evidence carries no name; names come from the answer history
policy_preset_aggregate_hint: Unions the reviewed 24-list manifest, deduplicated. Russia outside is excluded and Russian state/internal names are always kept direct.
policy_local_entries_hint: One domain or IPv4/CIDR per line. Blank lines and comments are ignored. Entries are added to the selected source; Russian state/internal domain names and excluded domains are refused. CIDR ranges are matched by address and can cover protected destinations, so add only ranges you intend to proxy.
policy_excluded_domains_hint: Domains that must never enter the PROXY set. One bare domain or *. entry per line; blank lines and comments are ignored. Excluding a subdomain also removes a broader parent rule, so the whole parent stays direct. IPv4/CIDR entries are not accepted here.
policy_inventory_override_hint: IPv4 prefixes this deployment routes direct by the Russian allocation set instead of relying on the shipped set alone. One prefix per line; blank lines and comments are ignored. The override takes precedence for every address it contains and cannot route a prohibited or internal destination.
policy_inventory_override_none: none — the shipped set is the only authority
policy_inventory_override_clear_hint: Clearing this field changes new routing decisions only; connections that are already established keep the path they chose.
policy_inventory_unusable: The address inventory is unusable; address-based direct routing is unavailable, while routing backed by retained DNS evidence stays active.
settings_save_read_failed: Could not read the stored settings, so nothing was saved
settings_test_saves_first: Saves the settings above first, then sends now
policy_save_kept: The server refused this change. Your edits are still in the form and are not saved.
policy_upstream_save_kept: Your edits are still in the editor and are not saved.
